#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

using llong = long long;
using pii = pair<int, int>;

const llong INF = 1e18;

struct Edge {
    int u, v;
    llong capacity, flow;
    llong cost;
    int rev;
};

class MinCostFlow {
private:
    int nodes;
    int source, sink;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    vector<Edge> edge_list;
    vector<llong> dist;
    vector<int> prev_node, prev_edge;
    vector<bool> in_queue;
    queue<int> q;
    
public:
    MinCostFlow(int n, int s, int t) : nodes(n), source(s), sink(t) {
        adj.resize(n);
        dist.resize(n);
        prev_node.resize(n);
        prev_edge.resize(n);
        in_queue.resize(n, false);
    }
    
    void add_edge(int from, int to, llong cap, llong cost) {
        int idx1 = edge_list.size();
        int idx2 = edge_list.size() + 1;
        adj[from].push_back(idx1);
        adj[to].push_back(idx2);
        edge_list.push_back({from, to, cap, 0, cost, idx2});
        edge_list.push_back({to, from, 0, 0, -cost, idx1});
    }
    
    bool shortest_path() {
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
        while (!q.empty()) q.pop();
        dist[source] = 0;
        q.push(source);
        in_queue[source] = true;
        
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            in_queue[u] = false;
            
            for (int idx : adj[u]) {
                Edge& e = edge_list[idx];
                if (e.capacity - e.flow > 0 && dist[u] + e.cost < dist[e.v]) {
                    dist[e.v] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                    prev_node[e.v] = u;
                    prev_edge[e.v] = idx;
                    if (!in_queue[e.v]) {
                        q.push(e.v);
                        in_queue[e.v] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        return dist[sink] < INF;
    }
    
    pair<llong, llong> compute_min_cost() {
        llong total_flow = 0, total_cost = 0;
        while (shortest_path()) {
            llong bottleneck = INF;
            for (int v = sink; v != source; v = prev_node[v]) {
                Edge& e = edge_list[prev_edge[v]];
                bottleneck = min(bottleneck, e.capacity - e.flow);
            }
            
            for (int v = sink; v != source; v = prev_node[v]) {
                Edge& e = edge_list[prev_edge[v]];
                e.flow += bottleneck;
                edge_list[e.rev].flow -= bottleneck;
            }
            
            total_flow += bottleneck;
            total_cost += bottleneck * dist[sink];
        }
        return {total_flow, total_cost};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, m, k;
    llong c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    
    vector<int> a(k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
        a[i]--;
    }
    
    // Build graph with time expansion
    int MAX_T = n * k + 1;
    MinCostFlow network(n * MAX_T + 2, n * MAX_T, n * MAX_T + 1);
    int source = n * MAX_T;
    int sink = n * MAX_T + 1;
    
    // Connect source to each person's starting position
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        network.add_edge(source, a[i], 1, 0);
    }
    
    // Connect each node at time t to node at time t+1 (waiting)
    for (int t = 0; t < MAX_T - 1; t++) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            network.add_edge(t * n + i, (t + 1) * n + i, 1, 0);
        }
    }
    
    // Connect edges for walking along streets
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        u--; v--;
        
        for (int t = 0; t < MAX_T - 1; t++) {
            // u -> v
            network.add_edge(t * n + u, (t + 1) * n + v, 1, 0);
            // v -> u
            network.add_edge(t * n + v, (t + 1) * n + u, 1, 0);
        }
    }
    
    // Connect to sink when reaching node 0 (crossroad 1)
    for (int t = 0; t < MAX_T; t++) {
        network.add_edge(t * n + 0, sink, k, c * t);
    }
    
    // Handle the cost for multiple people walking on same street in same direction
    // We need to track how many people use each edge at each time
    // This is complex, so we use a different approach: model each person separately
    
    // Reset and use a better approach: min cost flow with capacity handling
    // For each edge (u,v) at time t, if x people use it, cost is d*x^2
    // We can model this by adding multiple edges with increasing marginal cost
    
    // Actually, let's use a different formulation:
    // Create a node for each (person, time, location)
    // But that's too big. Instead, use the fact that d*x^2 can be modeled with
    // multiple edges: first person costs d, second costs 3d, third costs 5d, etc.
    
    // Let's rebuild with this insight
    // For each street (u,v) and each time t, we can have up to k people walking
    // The cost for q people is d*q^2 = d*(1 + 3 + 5 + ... + (2q-1))
    // So we can add q edges with costs d, 3d, 5d, etc.
    
    // Reset network
    network = MinCostFlow(n * MAX_T + 2, source, sink);
    
    // Connect source to each person's starting position
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        network.add_edge(source, a[i], 1, 0);
    }
    
    // Connect each node at time t to node at time t+1 (waiting)
    for (int t = 0; t < MAX_T - 1; t++) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            network.add_edge(t * n + i, (t + 1) * n + i, 1, 0);
        }
    }
    
    // For each street, add edges with increasing marginal costs
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        u--; v--;
        
        for (int t = 0; t < MAX_T - 1; t++) {
            // u -> v: add k edges with costs d, 3d, 5d, ..., (2k-1)d
            for (int q = 0; q < k; q++) {
                network.add_edge(t * n + u, (t + 1) * n + v, 1, d * (2 * q + 1));
            }
            // v -> u: add k edges with costs d, 3d, 5d, ..., (2k-1)d
            for (int q = 0; q < k; q++) {
                network.add_edge(t * n + v, (t + 1) * n + u, 1, d * (2 * q + 1));
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Connect to sink when reaching node 0 (crossroad 1)
    for (int t = 0; t < MAX_T; t++) {
        network.add_edge(t * n + 0, sink, k, c * t);
    }
    
    auto result = network.compute_min_cost();
    cout << result.second << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
